The equation for the reaction of magnesium with carbon dioxide is shown.
2Mg+CO2→2MgO+C
Which statement about this reaction is correct?
A
Magnesium is oxidised and carbon dioxide is reduced.
B
Magnesium is reduced and carbon dioxide is oxidised.
C
Magnesium and carbon dioxide are both oxidised.
D
Magnesium and carbon dioxide are neither oxidised nor reduced.

options.label: A
options.text: Magnesium is oxidised and carbon dioxide is reduced.

options.label: B
options.text: Magnesium is reduced and carbon dioxide is oxidised.

options.label: C
options.text: Magnesium and carbon dioxide are both oxidised.

options.label: D
options.text: Magnesium and carbon dioxide are neither oxidised nor reduced.
